Plan the channel copy and rename pass for a workspace

Source: R/channel-copy.R
channel_copy_plan.Rd

Compares the reviewed proposals against the workspace's live state and classifies every intended change. A row is "unchanged" when Slack already holds the proposed value, "drift" when the live value no longer matches what the review recorded (someone edited it since, so the proposal may be stale), "missing" when the channel is not in the workspace, and "apply" otherwise.

Usage

channel_copy_plan(
  workspace = c("organiser", "community"),
  index = NULL,
  proposals = NULL,
  renames = NULL
)

Arguments

workspace

Either "organiser" or "community".

index

Optional pre-fetched channel index, for testing.

proposals, renames

Optional proposal data frames, for testing.

Value

A data frame of planned changes.

Details

Renames are planned last so a rename cannot hide the channel from the copy rows in the same pass.
